mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course_personnel (course_id, student_id, student_score) VALUES (#{courseId}, #{studentId}, #{studentScore})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM course_personnel WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND student_id = #{studentId}

SELECT cp.course_id AS courseId, cp.student_id AS studentId, s.nickname AS nickname, s.avatar AS avatar, cp.student_score AS studentScore FROM course_personnel cp LEFT JOIN student s ON cp.student_id = s.student_id WHERE cp.course_id = #{courseId} ORDER BY cp.student_id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM course_personnel WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND student_id = #{studentId}
mapper.select: SELECT cp.* FROM course_personnel cp JOIN course c ON cp.course_id = c.course_id WHERE cp.student_id = #{studentId} AND c.is_finished = 1

SELECT s.student_id AS studentId, s.nickname AS nickname, COUNT(c.course_id) AS finishedCourseCount, COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN c.is_finished = 1 THEN cp.student_score END), 0) AS totalScore FROM student s LEFT JOIN course_personnel cp ON s.student_id = cp.student_id LEFT JOIN course c ON cp.course_id = c.course_id AND c.is_finished = 1 WHERE s.student_id = #{studentId} GROUP BY s.student_id, s.nickname
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(uer.exam_score), 0) FROM user_exam_record uer JOIN exam e ON uer.exam_id = e.exam_id WHERE e.course_id = #{courseId} AND uer.student_id = #{studentId}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.max_score), 0) FROM ( SELECT eq.exam_id, SUM(eq.score) AS max_score FROM exam_question eq JOIN exam e ON eq.exam_id = e.exam_id WHERE e.course_id = #{courseId} GROUP BY eq.exam_id ) t
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(uhr.homework_score), 0) FROM user_homework_record uhr JOIN homework h ON uhr.homework_id = h.homework_id WHERE h.course_id = #{courseId} AND uhr.student_id = #{studentId}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.max_score), 0) FROM ( SELECT hq.homework_id, SUM(hq.score) AS max_score FROM homework_question hq JOIN homework h ON hq.homework_id = h.homework_id WHERE h.course_id = #{courseId} GROUP BY hq.homework_id ) t

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(cir.score_value, 1)), 0) AS totalScore, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ciu.status != 0 THEN COALESCE(cir.score_value, 1) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS earnedScore, COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ciu.status != 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS attended FROM check_in_user ciu JOIN check_in_record cir ON ciu.check_in_id = cir.check_in_id WHERE cir.course_id = #{courseId} AND ciu.student_id = #{studentId}
